description: This file implements profiling functionality for Dynamo within PyTorch, including classes for collecting metrics and analyzing profiling results, as well as functions for integrating profiling into FX graphs.

classes.name: ProfileMetrics
classes.description: Class for collecting and aggregating performance metrics such as execution time, operator counts, and fusion statistics.

classes.name: ProfileResult
classes.description: Class for analyzing and reporting profiling results, including captured and total metrics and graph counts.

classes.name: Profiler
classes.description: Class that manages the profiling process, collects events, and computes profiling metrics.

methods.name: __iadd__
methods.description: In-place addition for ProfileMetrics and ProfileResult classes.

methods.name: percent
methods.description: Calculates the percentage of captured over total metrics.

methods.name: tocsv
methods.description: Converts metrics to a list suitable for CSV output.

methods.name: results
methods.description: Generates profiling results by processing recorded events.

methods.name: fx_insert_profiling
methods.description: Wraps a FX GraphModule with profiling instrumentation.
